reviews.comment: Extremely boring lectures, difficult to follow. Not many extra credit or curve opportunities. Unclear wording for problems on tests and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Fiorina is great. His lectures are awesome and it's abundantly clear he cares about his students. Only gripe I have is that his wording for quizzes/test questions can be unclear and can lead to (sometimes a lot) of confusion. Other than that he's amazing.

One of the best NUEN profs in the department teaching one of the most difficult courses. Difficult but fairly fun class if you get into it. Tests follow his reviews and notes very closely. You will spend a lot of time doing the homeworks though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Dr Fiorina is my absolute favorite professor who made me discover my passion for reactor design. If he has time outside of office hours he will answer your questions and make sure you understand Nuen 301 was supposedly the hardest class in nuclear engineering but I thrived. I owe my success in this course entirely to him. 
Thank you Dr. Fiorina !

Outstanding professor. NUEN 301 is a lot, but Dr Fiorina cares a lot about your understanding. He WILL make time for you to understand, but YOU have to go ask him. 

Homework is long and can be difficult, but I think it really brought our class together. I made a lot of good friends this year through 301. Go in with an open mind and ask questions!

Reactor theory is difficult content. Fiorina does a good job trying to explain how everything in his notes and lectures relates to the bigger picture of reactor behavior as a function of time, space, and energy. The homework is difficult and will take hours but it helps you a lot with the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things
